name: SkyTrace
install: python3 --version && python3 scripts/release_readiness.py --json > /tmp/skytrace-release-readiness.json && echo 'SkyTrace Python tooling OK (stdlib only, no external deps)'

terminals.description: Serves the static bilingual legal/support site (docs/site) at http://localhost:8000 — the App Review Privacy/Terms/Support pages generated by scripts/generate_legal_site.py. This is the only runnable app surface on Linux; the SkyTrace iOS app itself requires macOS + Xcode 26.
